# Shobhit Vats Sharma (Shobhit Vats)

> Official portfolio of **Shobhit Vats Sharma** (commonly searched as **Shobhit Vats**) — Final-year BS-MS researcher at IISER Pune and systems builder working across Computational Structural Biology, Biotech Scientific Operations (Founder's Office), Clinical Genomics Knowledge Base Verification & Validation (KB V&V), and STEM LLM Evaluation.

- Canonical Site: https://shobhitvats.github.io/
- Location: Pune, Maharashtra, India
- GitHub: https://github.com/shobhitvats
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/shobhit-vats-s-204427132
- Live Scientific Platform (MolBridge): https://molbridge.streamlit.app/

## Featured Case Studies & Platforms
- [MolBridge: NonCovalent Atlas](https://shobhitvats.github.io/projects/molbridge.html): Open-access structural bioinformatics platform (Streamlit, FastAPI, Numba/Rust) mapping 15+ noncovalent interaction families.
- [Velsera — KB V&V Comparator Automation](https://shobhitvats.github.io/projects/velsera.html): Standalone clinical genomics validator & comparator achieving 100% team adoption across 3+ UAT rounds (endorsed by Dr. Gargi Nanda).
- [Nucleovir Therapeutics — Scientific Operations & Infrastructure](https://shobhitvats.github.io/projects/sciops.html): Founder's Office project systems, digital record organisation, documentation, and internal NAS/Samba setup (certified by Dr. Yogesh Ostwal, PhD).
- [Outlier — STEM LLM Evaluation, RLHF & Reasoning Audits](https://shobhitvats.github.io/projects/outlier.html): Frontier STEM LLM reasoning verification, hallucination auditing, RLHF critiques, and GEM prompting across Blackbeard, Ather, and Springer.
- [IISER Pune · Sai Lab — MS Thesis & Computational Structural Biology](https://shobhitvats.github.io/projects/sai-lab.html): Master's thesis ("Understanding the Roles of Non-Covalent Interactions in Biomolecular Structural Motifs") under Prof. Saikrishnan Kayarat and Prof. M. S. Madhusudhan across >1.2M CSD entries, experimental PDB loops, kinematic null models, ClinVar variants, and 214M AlphaFold v4 models on ParamBrahma HPC (upcoming peer-reviewed paper in preparation).
- [ΔΔG Protein Stability Calculator](https://shobhitvats.github.io/projects/ddg.html): GPU-accelerated AMBER ff14SB + LCPO SASA calculator with 4-stage crystallographic strain relaxation.
- [OptiScan Engine](https://shobhitvats.github.io/projects/optiscan.html): Zero-false-positive Python static analysis engine using LibCST for AI coding agents.
- [Aegis Intelligence Platform](https://shobhitvats.github.io/projects/aegis.html): Stealth Playwright + Chrome MV3 + SQLite Data-as-a-Service engine.
- [Project Clarity](https://shobhitvats.github.io/projects/clarity.html): AST-driven Python dependency knowledge graphs.
- [HEPBlenderFusion](https://shobhitvats.github.io/projects/hep.html): Real-time C++17 Geant4 to Blender bridge via gRPC & Protocol Buffers.
- [Computational Astrology Engine](https://shobhitvats.github.io/projects/computational-astrology.html): 50+ module Swiss Ephemeris mathematical modeling suite.
